query: Can travellers update the members in the group QR code for different trips?
reference_answer: The MyICA mobile app can store multiple group QR codes with different group members. Travellers can edit the members in a group by adding or removing the member profile and regenerating the QR code even in offline mode (i.e., without mobile data). Travellers have the option to customise group names (e.g., 'Family', or 'Friends') to better fit their travel requirements.
answer: Based on the available information, travellers cannot update the group QR code for different trips; there's no evidence to support this capability. [Document 1]
